label: Style
description: Interior design and decorating styles, including modern movements, historical rooms, and regional traditions.
notes: Room-wide interior design and decorating styles belong here, phrased as modifiers before “room.” Room functions and layouts belong in interior_space.bedroom and the other room lists; exterior architectural styles belong in place.architecture_style. Period groups describe stylistic origins or traditional use rather than restricting the setting era, and ornament remains an independent visual filter. Related families emphasize distinct furnishings or finishes; retrospective and regional looks may be used anywhere today.
